{{Short description|Russian physicist}}

''' Valery Nikolaevich Golubkin''' (born 1952<ref name="mipt">{{cite web|title=Голубкин Валерий Николаевич|url=https://mipt.ru/education/chairs/tipa/persons/golubkin.php|publisher= Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology|website=mipt.ru|date=26 June 2023|language=ru|access-date=26 June 2023}}</ref>) is a Russian [[physicist]] and former professor at the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]]. Golubkin worked at the department of ''theoretical and applied aerohydromechanics'' and is an expert for [[hypersonic]] technology. In April 2020 he was arrested on the suspicion of treason. He is accused of passing state secrets to an unnamed [[NATO]] country. His lawyer said that at the time Golubkin denied the charges against him. On the 26th of June in 2023 he was sentenced to 12 years in prison.<ref>{{cite web|title=Russian court jails scientist Golubkin for 12 years in treason case|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-court-jails-academic-golubkin-12-years-treason-2023-06-26/|publisher=Reuters|website=reuters.com|date=26 June 2023|access-date=26 June 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Russian Aerospace Scientist Jailed 12 Years for Treason – Reports|url=https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/06/26/russian-aerospace-scientist-jailed-12-years-for-treason-reports-a81644|publisher=Alexander Gubsky|website=The Moscow Times|date=26 June 2023|access-date=26 June 2023}}</ref>

Golubkin holds the academic degree "Doctor of Technical Sciences" since 1991.<ref name="mipt" />
